Alchemist.name: Bomb Thrower
Alchemist.html: Bomb Thrower: Your Bomb Throw has an effective range of 6 units and a maximum range of 8 units.

Alchemist.name: Unstable Bombs
Alchemist.html: Unstable Bombs: You gain the Unstable Bomb and Smoke Bomb variants of Bomb Throw.

Alchemist.name: Curious Concoctions
Alchemist.html: Curious Concoctions: Start each day with {{progression.concoctionPoints}} Concoction Points (CP). You know {{progression.concoctions}} concoctions. Create your known concoctions outside combat by spending their CP costs; each takes a few minutes to prepare and lasts only for the current day. Multiple uses of the same concoction do not stack.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

Archer.name: Bullseye
Archer.html: Bullseye: When you roll Double 6 on a Ranged Strike, roll 2 Extra Dice and add their successes to that roll.

Archer.name: Archery Points
Archer.html: Archery Points: Start each combat with {{progression.archeryPoints}} AP. Spend AP on abilities that list an AP cost; your pool resets at the start of each combat.

Archer.name: Special Shots
Archer.html: Special Shots: You gain the Pinning Shot and Puncturing Shot Ranged Strike variants.

Archer.name: Sliding Shot
Archer.html: Sliding Shot: You gain the Sliding Shot action.

Barbarian.name: Push Through Pain
Barbarian.html: Push Through Pain: Start each combat with {{progression.startingTempHp}} temporary HP. Lose all remaining temporary HP when combat ends.

Barbarian.name: Rage
Barbarian.html: Rage: Start each combat with 1 Rage. Gain 1 Rage whenever you damage an enemy, and 1 Rage per HP lost, including temporary HP. Spend Rage on your abilities; lose all unspent Rage when combat ends.

Barbarian.name: Ram
Barbarian.html: Ram: You gain the Ram Charge variant.

Barbarian.name: Aggressive Grapple
Barbarian.html: Aggressive Grapple: You gain the Aggressive Grapple variant of Grapple.

Barbarian.name: Enraged Toss
Barbarian.html: Enraged Toss: You gain the Enraged Toss Weapon Throw variant.

Barbarian.name: Angry Mind
Barbarian.html: Angry Mind: Rolls for attacks and effects against you that cause the Discouraged or Frightened conditions have disadvantage.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Harden
instincts.html: • Harden: When attacked, gain +1 Fortitude against that attack.

Bard.name: Bardic Music
Bard.html: Bardic Music: You can play any musical instrument and add magical sounds to musical performances. You have advantage on Performance rolls for music.

Bard.name: War Singing
Bard.html:
War Singing: During the Beginning Phase, choose one phrase not yet used this combat. This requires no action. It affects creatures within 6 units at that moment for the round, even if they later move.

  • Rise to the Challenge: All affected allies become Inspired 1 (1 Extra Die on rolls) until the end of the round.
  • Onward We Go: All affected allies gain +1 Movement until the end of the round.
  • Looming Darkness: Roll Magic against each affected enemy’s Will. On success, it becomes Discouraged until the end of the round.

Bard.name: War Singing phrases
Bard.html:
• Sweet, Sweet Revenge: Choose an enemy that damaged you this combat. It becomes Vulnerable and Discouraged until the end of the round.
  • For Our Friends: If a party member became Dying this combat, affected allies gain advantage on all rolls until the end of the round. Dying party members gain advantage on their stabilization roll.

Bard.name: Enchanted Melodies
Bard.html: Enchanted Melodies: Outside combat, perform Melody of Rest once per day to heal party members within 20 units for 1 HP.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

Bard.name: Spellcasting
Bard.omitReason: Counts, traditions and learned magic are shown in Spellcasting and Spells Known.

Cleric.name: Blessed Strike
Cleric.html: Blessed Strike: For Melee Strikes with a one-handed weapon, you may roll Magic instead of Melee. You may deal Radiant or your domain’s damage type instead of the weapon’s damage type.

Cleric.name: Prayer
Cleric.html: Prayer: Start each combat with 1 Faith and gain 1 Faith whenever you perform an action. Spend Faith on Prayer options; see the Prayer action.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

Cleric.name: Spellcasting
Cleric.omitReason: Counts, traditions and learned magic are shown in Spellcasting and Spells Known.

Druid.name: Student of the Wild (1 / Combat)
Druid.html: Student of the Wild (1 / Combat): Before committing to an action, reveal one beast or elemental enemy’s action. No action required.

Druid.name: Wild Shape
Druid.html: Wild Shape: While shapeshifted, use your form’s senses, features, Movement, Deflection, Fortitude, Athletics, Acrobatics, and melee range. You can speak with animals but cannot speak normally, use armor or weapons, or cast spells or cantrips. Existing spells continue. Animal Strike is your only Strike action; its damage type and Double 6 effect depend on your form.

instincts.name: Wildshape
instincts.html: • Wildshape: At any point during the round, become a Small or Medium non-flying animal, change animal form, or return to normal. You cannot transform while wearing armor without the Wild property. See Wild Shape in Class Features for the rules while transformed.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

Druid.name: Spellcasting
Druid.omitReason: Counts, traditions and learned magic are shown in Spellcasting and Spells Known.

Paladin.name: Devotion
Paladin.html: Devotion: Spend Devotion Points on your abilities. Your pool refills when you rest; its current capacity is recorded under Additional Features.

Paladin.name: Holy Smite
Paladin.html: Holy Smite: You gain the Holy Smite Melee Strike variant.

Paladin.name: Inspiring Strike
Paladin.html: Inspiring Strike: After a successful Melee Strike, choose an ally within 10 units. It becomes Inspired 1 (1 Extra Die on rolls) until the end of the round.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Harden
instincts.html: • Harden: When attacked, gain +1 Fortitude against that attack.

instincts.name: Rally (1 / Combat)
instincts.html:
• Rally (1 / Combat): During the Beginning Phase, choose an option affecting you and allies within 6 units.
    • Grit: Gain 1 temporary HP until combat ends.
    • Courage: Become immune to Frightened and Discouraged until combat ends.

Ranger.name: Hunter's Edge
Ranger.html: Hunter's Edge: On the first round of combat, your Melee Strikes and Ranged Strikes have advantage against enemies that have not yet acted.

Ranger.name: Favored Enemy
Ranger.html: Favored Enemy: Gain 2 Extra Dice on Melee Strikes and Ranged Strikes against {{choices.favored}}, and advantage on Deduction, Stealth, Survival, Nature, and Notice Movement rolls against it. You may replace your favored enemy after a week of downtime studying the new type.

Ranger.name: Know Your Enemy (1 / Combat)
Ranger.html: Know Your Enemy (1 / Combat): During the Planning Phase, reveal the action of one enemy of the {{choices.favored}} type.

instincts.name: Expose Weaknesses
instincts.html: • Expose Weaknesses: During the Beginning Phase, choose an enemy you can see. During the next Planning Phase, learn its damage resistances and vulnerabilities. The first attack against it by you or an ally next round has advantage.

Rogue.name: Sneak Attack
Rogue.html: Sneak Attack: When you have advantage on a Melee Strike or Weapon Throw, add 3 Extra Dice to the roll. None of the weapons used for the attack may have the Heavy, Reach, or Two-Handed properties.

Rogue.name: Slippery
Rogue.html: Slippery: Gain +1 Deflection while wearing neither Medium nor Heavy armor and wielding neither a shield nor a Heavy weapon.

Rogue.name: Lockpicking
Rogue.html: Lockpicking: You have proficiency with Thieves Tools.

Rogue.name: Basic Dual Wielding
Rogue.html: Basic Dual Wielding: Wield two one-handed weapons, at most one Heavy. Make one Melee Strike roll using both weapons’ Extra Dice, the higher Minimum Roll, one available damage type, and one weapon’s Double 6 effect.

Rogue.name: Seize the Moment
Rogue.html: Seize the Moment: When you perform a Melee Strike against an enemy within an ally's melee reach, you have advantage on the roll.

instincts.name: Evasive Maneuver
instincts.html: • Evasive Maneuver: Halve damage from one source, rounded down.

Spellsword.name: Martial Weapon Proficiency
Spellsword.html: Martial Weapon Proficiency: You may use martial weapons.

Spellsword.name: Arcane Strike
Spellsword.html: Arcane Strike: When making a Melee Strike with a one-handed weapon, you may gain 2 Extra Dice and change its damage type to Fire, Ice, or Lightning.

Spellsword.name: Arcane Diffusion
Spellsword.html: Arcane Diffusion: Casting an Arcane spell or cantrip grants +1 Deflection until the end of the next two rounds. Further castings refresh the duration without stacking the bonus. Spells and cantrips that themselves grant Deflection do not trigger this benefit.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

Spellsword.name: Spellcasting
Spellsword.omitReason: Counts, traditions and learned magic are shown in Spellcasting and Spells Known.

Warrior.name: Student of War (1 / Combat)
Warrior.html: Student of War (1 / Combat): During the Planning Phase, reveal the action and its targets of one humanoid enemy.

Warrior.name: Tactical Strike
Warrior.html:
Tactical Strike: Once per round, after a successful Melee Strike, choose one effect:

  • Push: Force-push the target 1 unit in any direction.
  • Breach: The target becomes Breached 1 (−1 Deflection) until the end of the next round.
  • Disable: The target has disadvantage on its next attack.
  • Reposition: Move 1 unit.
  • Trip (penalty of 2 on the roll): The target becomes Prone if it is no more than one size larger than you.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

instincts.name: Opportunity Attacks
instincts.html: • Opportunity Attacks: When an enemy leaves your melee reach after starting the Action Phase within it, immediately perform a Melee Strike against it.

instincts.name: Counter
instincts.html: • Counter: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack. Afterward, you may perform a Melee Strike against the attacker if it is within your melee reach.

instincts.name: Protect & Serve
instincts.html: • Protect & Serve: When an ally within your melee reach is attacked, swap places and become the target. Then perform a Melee Strike against the attacker if it is within your melee reach.

instincts.name: Harden
instincts.html: • Harden: When attacked, gain +1 Fortitude against that attack.

Occultist.name: Occultist’s Familiar
Occultist.html: Occultist’s Familiar: Your Tiny animal or demon familiar has 1 HP and 1 Deflection. It is incorporeal and cannot be affected, but cannot pass through obstacles or walls. In combat it can only Dash. Cast a spell from its position to make it corporeal for the rest of combat. It is banished instead of dying. During a long rest, perform a ritual to restore it or change its form. It speaks one language you know; you can communicate telepathically with each other within 60 units.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

Occultist.name: Spellcasting
Occultist.omitReason: Counts, traditions and learned magic are shown in Spellcasting and Spells Known.

Wizard.name: Student of Magic (1 / Combat)
Wizard.html: Student of Magic (1 / Combat): During the Planning Phase, you may reveal if a spell is being cast by a chosen enemy, and what that spell is.

Wizard.name: Fae Familiar
Wizard.html: Fae Familiar: Your Tiny animal or Fae familiar has 1 HP, 1 Deflection, and Movement 5. It is incorporeal and cannot be affected, but cannot pass through obstacles or walls. In combat it can only Dash. Cast a spell from its position to make it corporeal for the rest of combat. It is banished instead of dying. During a long rest, perform a ritual to restore it or change its form; alternatively, spend 2 Spell Points on a one-minute ritual. It speaks one language you know; you can communicate telepathically with each other within 60 units.

instincts.name: Unleash
instincts.html: • Unleash: When you roll, add 1 Extra Die.

instincts.name: Evade
instincts.html: • Evade: When attacked, gain +1 Deflection against that attack.

instincts.name: Still Mind
instincts.html: • Still Mind: When attacked, gain +1 Will against that attack.

Wizard.name: Spellcasting
Wizard.omitReason: Counts, traditions and learned magic are shown in Spellcasting and Spells Known.

Zephyr.name: Martial Arts Disciple
Zephyr.html: Martial Arts Disciple: Gain 2 Extra Dice on Unarmed Strike rolls and Melee Strike rolls using daggers. You may roll with the Unarmed skill when you perform a Melee Strike with daggers and quarterstaffs.

Zephyr.name: Wind Walk
Zephyr.html: Wind Walk: While wearing no armor and wielding neither a shield nor a Heavy weapon, gain +2 Movement and +1 Deflection. You may move through enemies’ spaces but cannot stop there. Moving at least 4 units and ending at least 2 units from your starting position grants another +1 Deflection until the end of the round, including movement made as part of an action.

Zephyr.name: Momentum
Zephyr.html:
Momentum: You start each combat in Momentum tier 1. At the end of each round, if you moved at least 4 units during that round, you gain 1 tier of Momentum (maximum tier 3). When combat starts and whenever you gain a tier, roll Unarmed to determine the additional benefit you get from your new tier. See the table at the bottom. Whenever you receive damage, you lose one tier (minimum tier 1). All associated benefits of the tier you lost are lost as well.

Shadow Clone: When you get the Shadow Clone benefit, you immediately create a clone of yourself in a nearby location that is closest to you. The clone is a separate actor you control in a similar manner. The clone shares your Movement score and your Unarmed bonus. The clone can only perform Unarmed Strike, dealing the same damage as you normally deal. It doesn't get the Strike damage benefit from Momentum. The Shadow Clone cannot be affected or damaged. If you lose the ability or become unconscious, or if the clone moved less than 4 units during the round, the clone dissipates.

Whirlwind: When you get the Whirlwind benefit, starting next round, at the end of each round, you create a slashing wind around you. Roll Unarmed against Deflection for all enemies that are adjacent to you. Deal 1 Slashing damage to each enemy you succeed against.

Gale: When you get the Gale benefit, starting next round, during the Beginning Phase of each round, choose two targets you can see within 10 units of you that are up to one size larger than you. You may forcefully push them up to 2 units. This also counts as 1 damage for the purpose of interruption.

  • Tier 1 — 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 SD: +2 Movement / strikes force-push 1 unit / strikes apply Prone / choose a Tier 1 benefit.
  • Tier 2 — 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 SD: Gale / Whirlwind / Shadow Clone / choose a Tier 2 benefit.
  • Tier 3 — 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 SD: Strikes gain 4 Extra Dice and deal Slashing / same / strikes gain 4 Extra Dice and deal Force / choose an unused benefit from any tier.

Zephyr.name: Agile Fall
Zephyr.html: Agile Fall: Take half falling damage, rounded down. Falling damage begins after 4 units instead of 2.

Zephyr.name: Deflect Missiles
Zephyr.html: Deflect Missiles: Once per round when hit by a Ranged Strike or Weapon Throw, redirect the attack to another target within 5 units of you, or avoid it if you choose no target.

Zephyr.name: Forceful Maneuver
Zephyr.html: Forceful Maneuver: You gain the Forceful Maneuver action.

Skald.name: Art of Fighting
Skald.html: Art of Fighting: You gain proficiency with martial weapons, heavy shields, and medium armor.

instincts.name: Embellish
instincts.html: • Embellish: When you or a creature within 6 units attacks, add 1 Extra Die to its roll.

instincts.name: Downplay
instincts.html: • Downplay: When you or a creature within 6 units attacks, spend 1 Spell Point to apply a penalty of 1 to its roll.

instincts.name: Reenact: The Dragon Slayer
instincts.html:
• Reenact: The Dragon Slayer: During the Beginning Phase, spend 1 Spell Point to designate an enemy as the Dragon and an ally as the Knight, both within 12 units. The Knight has advantage on attacks against the Dragon until combat ends or the Grand Finale.
    • Grand Finale: If the Knight reduces the Dragon to 0 HP, allies within 3 units of the Knight become Inspired 1 (1 Extra Die on rolls) for the next round.

instincts.name: Reenact: The Martyr
instincts.html:
• Reenact: The Martyr: During the Beginning Phase, spend 1 Spell Point to designate a willing ally within 12 units as the Martyr. Until combat ends or the Grand Finale, damage dealt to its allies within 6 units is dealt to the Martyr instead.
    • Grand Finale: When the Martyr reaches 0 HP, it has 1 HP instead and stops absorbing damage. Its allies within 6 units gain 1 temporary HP.

Tale Weaver.name: Historian
Tale Weaver.omitReason: Training is included in the skills tables.

Muse.name: Glamorous Spellcasting
Muse.html: Glamorous Spellcasting: Gain 1 temporary Spell Point at the start of combat, usable only for non-damaging spells. A spell cast with it gains 1 Extra Die on its roll. Lose the point if unspent when combat ends.

instincts.name: Dazzle
instincts.html: • Dazzle: When you or a creature within 6 units rolls Performance or a Speech skill, spend 1 Spell Point to grant advantage. Usable outside combat.

instincts.name: Confuse
instincts.html: • Confuse: When a creature within 6 units rolls, spend 1 Spell Point to impose disadvantage. Usable outside combat.

Muse.name: Difficult to Ignore
Muse.omitReason: Training is included in the skills tables.

Exarch.name: Divine Conduit
Exarch.html: Divine Conduit: You may use Prayer one additional time per combat and gain its Alacrity option.

actionOptions.html: Alacrity (1 Faith): Your party members gain +2 Movement until the end of the round.

instincts.name: Radiating Devotion
instincts.html: • Radiating Devotion: When allies within 8 units roll Intimidation, Athletics, Acrobatics, or Performance, spend 1 Spell Point to grant advantage. One activation can affect multiple allies in a group roll. Outside combat, no Instinct is required.

instincts.name: Zeal
instincts.html: • Zeal: When an ally within 8 units performs a Strike or damaging cantrip, spend at least 1 Spell Point. Add 1 Extra Die to its roll per point spent.

Hierophant.name: Divine Messenger
Hierophant.html: Divine Messenger: Cast Thaumaturgy whenever you could speak, without spending time or effort. You may combine any number of its effects in one casting.

Hierophant.name: Commanding Presence
Hierophant.html: Commanding Presence: Gain 1 Hierophant Spell Point at the start of combat. Spend it to cast or empower any non-damaging spell you can normally cast. Lose it if unspent when combat ends.

instincts.name: Forbidden Target
instincts.html: • Forbidden Target: When an enemy attacks you, spend 1 Spell Point and roll Magic against its Will. On success, it must choose another valid target or cancel the attack. Enemies immune to Frightened are unaffected.

Warden.name: Protector
Warden.html: Protector: Gain Medium Armor proficiency. Your spellcasting is interrupted after taking 3 damage instead of 2.

Warden.name: Kindness of God
Warden.html: Kindness of God: When you cast Cure as a Fast Action, you may heal two targets as though you had used its Slow, interruptible casting.

instincts.name: Combat Vitality
instincts.html: • Combat Vitality: After performing an action in combat that costs no Spell Points, spend at least 1 Spell Point to heal an ally other than yourself within 8 units for 2 HP per point.

Worldshaper.name: World Magic
Worldshaper.html: World Magic: Gain 1 temporary Spell Point at the start of combat, usable only to cast Nature spells. Lose it if unspent when combat ends.

Worldshaper.name: Earth Bending
Worldshaper.html: Earth Bending: When you cast Mold Earth using Cast a Cantrip, you may immediately cast it a second time.

instincts.name: Defensive Earth Bending
instincts.html: • Defensive Earth Bending: When you or an ally within 6 units is attacked by a ranged attack, cast Mold Earth at a point within 1 unit of the target, potentially imposing disadvantage or making the attack impossible.

Shephard.name: Multiple Summons
Shephard.html: Multiple Summons: You can maintain one additional summon.

instincts.name: Combat Summoning
instincts.html: • Combat Summoning: During the Beginning Phase, cast a summoning spell for twice its normal Spell Point cost.

Werebeast.name: Combat Shifter
Werebeast.html: Combat Shifter: You may shapeshift into Large animals. Gain 4 Extra Dice on Animal Strike rolls.

Werebeast.name: Wildshape Spellcasting
Werebeast.html: Wildshape Spellcasting: You may cast spells while shapeshifted into Small or larger animals.

Werebeast.name: Wildshape Communication
Werebeast.html: Wildshape Communication: While shapeshifted, you may speak telepathically with any number of creatures within 30 units of you.

Exemplar.name: Touch of Kindness
Exemplar.html: Touch of Kindness: Renewal also removes one condition from the target: Discouraged, Frightened, or Disoriented.

Exemplar.name: Sphere of Protection
Exemplar.html: Sphere of Protection: You gain the Sphere of Protection action.

instincts.name: Become the Shield
instincts.html: • Become the Shield: When an ally within 6 units is hit, negate its damage and take half that amount yourself, rounded up. Other attack effects still apply to the ally.

Avenger.name: Deliver Judgment
Avenger.html: Deliver Judgment: Hitting an enemy with Holy Smite makes it Marked for Judgment until combat ends. If Holy Smite kills it, choose another enemy you can see to mark instead. Gain 2 Extra Dice on Melee Strikes against marked enemies.

Avenger.name: Pursue the Wicked
Avenger.html: Pursue the Wicked: Once per round, spend 1 Devotion Point to gain +2 Movement until the end of the round. No action required.

instincts.name: Swift Revenge
instincts.html: • Swift Revenge: When an enemy damages you or an ally, make it Marked for Judgment. Only one enemy may be marked at a time.

Justiciar.name: Holy Decrees
Justiciar.omitReason: Options are nested under the Rally Instinct ability.

instinctOptions.html:
• Decree of the Honorable Duel (2 Devotion Points): Choose a point within range. Until combat ends, a creature within 10 units of that point that damages another becomes Engaged with it, and vice versa. An Engaged creature loses 2 HP whenever it targets anyone other than its partner. Engagement ends for both when either reaches 0 HP. Each creature can be Engaged with only one other creature.
  • Decree of the Fair Fight (2 Devotion Points): Choose a point within range. Until combat ends, a creature within 10 units of it loses 2 HP if it damages a target another creature has already damaged this round. Hordes and Swarms instead lose 2 HP each time they attack.

instincts.name: Balance
instincts.html: • Balance: When a creature within 6 units makes an attack roll, cancel all advantage and disadvantage on it.

Assassin.name: First Blood
Assassin.html: First Blood: During the first round of combat, gain 2 Extra Dice on Melee Strikes and Weapon Throws against enemies that have not yet acted.

instincts.name: Combat Poisoner
instincts.html: • Combat Poisoner: During the Beginning Phase, apply poison instead of using its normal Fast Action. Your action gains 1 Drag this round.

Assassin.name: Infiltrator
Assassin.omitReason: Training is included in the skills tables.

Fae Trickster.name: Fae Evasion
Fae Trickster.html: Fae Evasion: When you use Evasive Maneuver, you may also immediately teleport a distance up to your Movement score.

Fae Trickster.name: Whimsical Enchantments
Fae Trickster.html: Whimsical Enchantments: You gain the Fae Dust Cloud action.

instincts.name: Fidgety
instincts.html: • Fidgety: At any point during the round, gain +2 Movement until the end of the round or use Sleight of Hand for a mischievous deed.

Fae Trickster.name: Trickery of the Fae
Fae Trickster.omitReason: Training is included in the skills tables.

Toymaker.name: Mechanism Points
Toymaker.html: Mechanism Points: Start each day with 3 Mechanism Points (MP). Spend them to create mechanisms; they fall apart at the end of the day. Some cannot be built during combat.

Toymaker.name: Mechanisms
Toymaker.html:
Clockwork Walker (1 MP): Tiny; 1 HP; Movement 3. You control it as a separate actor. Its clicking distracts observers, granting you advantage on Sneak against them. Activate it with a Fast Action; it becomes disabled after two rounds or twelve seconds. Choose a function when building it, and modify it later if desired.

  • Jumper: Fast Action: jump up to 2 units toward a Large or smaller enemy’s face. Attacks against it have advantage this round; the walker then becomes disabled.
  • Bomb Carrier: Load a bomb supplied separately. Fast Action: detonate it with its normal effects, destroying the walker.

Beartrap (1 MP): A Large or smaller creature stepping on the trap takes 1 Piercing damage and becomes Slowed (1 Drag and −1 Movement) until the end of the next round.

Jumping Boots (1 MP): Wear over your boots using a Slow Action. As part of movement, jump 3 additional units straight forward or 2 units higher vertically. The boots are destroyed after one use.

instincts.name: Activate Clockwork Walker
instincts.html: • Activate Clockwork Walker: During the Beginning Phase, activate a Clockwork Walker instead of using its Fast Action activation.

Toymaker.name: Mechanist
Toymaker.omitReason: Training is included in the skills tables.

Ravager.name: Who Needs a Shield
Ravager.html: Who Needs a Shield: Gain +1 Deflection while holding at least one weapon and no shield.

Ravager.name: Basic Dual Wielding
Ravager.html: Basic Dual Wielding: Wield two one-handed weapons, at most one Heavy. Make one Melee Strike roll using both weapons’ Extra Dice, the higher Minimum Roll, one available damage type, and one weapon’s Double 6 effect.

Ravager.name: Bloody Momentum
Ravager.html: Bloody Momentum: Killing an enemy with a Melee Strike grants 1 additional Instinct until the end of the round.

Sentinel.name: None Shall Escape
Sentinel.html: None Shall Escape: You may trigger Opportunity Attacks as if your melee reach was larger by 1 unit. If you do so, move 1 unit towards the target, bringing them into your melee reach.

Sentinel.name: Defender Strikes
Sentinel.html: Defender Strikes: Your Tactical Strike gains Challenge: the target has disadvantage on attacks against anyone other than you until the end of the next round.

Witchblade.name: Eldritch Tactics
Witchblade.html:
Eldritch Tactics: Your Tactical Strike gains these options:

  • Condemn (penalty of 2 on the roll): The target becomes Vulnerable 1 (−1 to all defenses) until the end of the next round.
  • Sicken: The target becomes Disoriented 1 (a penalty of 1 on all rolls) until the end of the next round.

Spell Counterstrikes: You may use a Touch-range cantrip instead of Melee Strike for Opportunity Attacks and Counter.

Witchblade.name: Student of the Dark
Witchblade.html: Student of the Dark: You can use the Student of War feature against abominations and fiends as well as humanoids.

Witchblade.name: Occult Spellcasting
Witchblade.omitReason: Training and spellcasting are included in their dedicated sections.

Witchblade.name: Mutant Body
Witchblade.html: Mutant Body: One minute after drinking a potion, gain advantage on your next Melee Strike. Once per combat.

Witchblade.name: Vile Slash
Witchblade.html: Vile Slash: You gain the Vile Slash Melee Strike variant.

Phantasmist.name: Fracture Reality
Phantasmist.html:
Fracture Reality: Gain 1 Fracture Spell Point at the start of combat, usable only for spells rolled against Will. Lose it if unspent when combat ends. When casting with it, choose one benefit:

  • Double: Immediately cast a single-target spell again against a second target, paying for the additional casting.
  • Extend: Extend a spell’s duration until the end of combat.

instincts.name: Mind Games
instincts.html: • Mind Games: At any point during the round, cast an Illusion spell for 1 additional Spell Point.

War Mage.name: Battle Casting
War Mage.html: Battle Casting: A cantrip that deals damage and normally has Average speed has Fast speed for you instead.

War Mage.name: Evocation Specialist
War Mage.html: Evocation Specialist: Gain 1 Evocation Spell Point at the start of combat, usable only to cast a damaging spell. That casting counts as spending 1 additional Spell Point. Lose the point if unspent when combat ends.

Chronomancer.name: Secrets of Chronomancy
Chronomancer.html: Secrets of Chronomancy: You may learn and cast Chrono spells whose requirements you meet.

instincts.name: Redo
instincts.html: • Redo: Right after a creature within 6 units rolls, spend 1 Spell Point to make it reroll and use the new result. Only once per roll; cannot affect rolls for activities lasting more than a minute. Usable outside combat.

Pyre.name: Infernal Rage Aura
Pyre.html: Infernal Rage Aura: Activate or deactivate the aura during the Beginning Phase. While active, at the end of each round, you and all other creatures within 1 unit take 1 Fire damage automatically. Your self-damage cannot be mitigated. Gain 1 additional Rage per other creature damaged, stacking with normal Rage gains. Self-damage grants only the normal Rage for losing HP.

Pyre.name: Flaming Strikes
Pyre.html: Flaming Strikes: When you perform a Melee Strike or Unarmed Strike, you may spend additional Rage to extend its range by 1 unit for each Rage spent. If you spend Rage this way, the Strike deals Fire damage instead of its normal damage type.

Pyre.name: Ultimate: Fiery Eruption
Pyre.html: Fiery Eruption: You gain the Fiery Eruption action.

instincts.name: Hot Retaliation
instincts.html: • Hot Retaliation: When an enemy within 6 units attacks you, deal 1 Fire damage to yourself and 2 Fire damage to it. Self-damage cannot be mitigated. Gain 1 additional Rage if the enemy takes damage, stacking with normal Rage gains. Self-damage grants only normal Rage for losing HP.

Berserker.name: Bloodlust
Berserker.html: Bloodlust: Gain 2 temporary HP when you kill an enemy with Weapon Throw or an enemy dies within your melee range. Each death grants this benefit once.

Berserker.name: Ultimate: Whirlwind
Berserker.html: Ultimate: Whirlwind: You gain the Whirlwind special action.

instincts.name: Limit Break
instincts.html: • Limit Break: At any point during the round, lose 2 HP to perform a Melee Strike, Unarmed Strike, Grapple, or Weapon Throw, including available variants. Normal costs, requirements, and usage limits still apply.

Walking Ballista.name: Hardwall
Walking Ballista.html: Hardwall: You gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

Walking Ballista.name: Deployment
Walking Ballista.html:
Deployment: Use the Deploy Instinct ability to become deployed. While deployed:

  • You gain +1 Deflection and +1 Fortitude.
  • You may use Ballista abilities.
  • You may use only ranged weapons and bombs.
  • You provide Half Cover to adjacent creatures of your size and Full Cover to adjacent creatures smaller than you.
  • You cannot move.
  • You cannot use the Evade Instinct ability.

Walking Ballista.name: Power Shot
Walking Ballista.html: Power Shot: You gain the Power Shot Ranged Strike variant.

Walking Ballista.name: Bomb Slinging
Walking Ballista.html: Bomb Slinging: You gain the Bomb Slinging Bomb Throw variant.

Walking Ballista.name: Caltrops
Walking Ballista.html: Caltrops: You gain the Caltrops Ranged Strike variant.

instincts.name: Deploy
instincts.html: • Deploy: Become deployed.

instincts.name: Undeploy
instincts.html: • Undeploy: Stop being deployed.

Walking Ballista.name: Mechanical Expert
Walking Ballista.omitReason: Training is included in the skills tables.

Bowslinger.name: Moving Target
Bowslinger.html: Moving Target: When you finish moving at least 3 units from your starting position, gain +1 Deflection until the end of the round.

Bowslinger.name: Combat Archery
Bowslinger.html: Combat Archery: Your Ranged Strikes do not suffer disadvantage from being within an enemy's melee reach, and enemies gain no benefit from Half Cover against them.

Bowslinger.name: Multishot
Bowslinger.html: Multishot: You gain the Multishot Ranged Strike variant.

instincts.name: Quickshot (1 AP)
instincts.html: • Quickshot (1 AP): At any point during the round, perform a Ranged Strike dealing half normal damage, rounded up.

instincts.name: Countershot
instincts.html: • Countershot: When an enemy attacks you or an ally within your weapon’s effective range, impose disadvantage on its attack. If it is a Ranged Strike, cancel it instead.

Arcane Archer.name: Elemental Archery
Arcane Archer.html:
Elemental Archery: Whenever you perform a Ranged Strike, you may change its damage type to Fire, Ice, or Lightning. If you do, replace the weapon's Double 6 effect for that Strike with the corresponding effect from Elemental Flare:

  • Fire: the target becomes Burning 1 until the end of the round (it takes 1 Fire damage at the end of the round).
  • Ice: the target becomes Chilled 2 (-2 Movement) until the end of the next round.
  • Lightning: the target becomes Disoriented 1 (a penalty of 1 on all rolls) until the end of the next round.

Arcane Archer.name: Force Arrow
Arcane Archer.html: Force Arrow: You gain the Force Arrow action.

Arcane Archer.name: Exploding Arrow
Arcane Archer.html: Exploding Arrow: You gain the Exploding Arrow action.

Arcane Archer.name: Thunder Arrow
Arcane Archer.html: Thunder Arrow: You gain the Thunder Arrow action.

instincts.name: Ice-Surfing
instincts.html: • Ice-Surfing: Gain +2 Movement until the end of the round.

instincts.name: Arcane Shield (2 AP)
instincts.html: • Arcane Shield (2 AP): At any point during the round, gain +2 Deflection and immunity to Magic Missile until the end of the round.

Arcane Archer.name: Arcane Expertise
Arcane Archer.omitReason: Training is included in the skills tables.

Defiler.name: Bonus Cantrip
Defiler.omitReason: The granted cantrip is included in Spells Known.

Defiler.name: Vile Spell Point
Defiler.html: Vile Spell Point: Gain 1 Vile Spell Point at the start of combat. Spend it to cast or empower a spell that applies negative conditions. Increase each leveled negative condition it applies by 1 level. Lose the point if unspent when combat ends.

instincts.name: Hexcraft
instincts.html:
• Hexcraft: When you apply Vulnerable, Poisoned, Decayed, or Weakened to an enemy, choose one condition just applied and one benefit:
    • Spread: Apply it at the same level to up to two other enemies within 3 units of the original target, until the end of the next round.
    • Intensify: Increase its level on the original target by 1 without changing its duration.

Human.name: Legacy of Discovery
Human.html: Legacy of Discovery: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}} and Adept (4d6) in {{choices.legacy-adept}}.

Human.name: Origin Feat
Human.html: Origin Feat: You gain one Origin Feat.

instincts.name: Human Adaptiveness (1 / Day)
instincts.html: • Human Adaptiveness (1 / Day): When you roll, gain advantage. Usable outside combat.

Orc.name: Legacy of War
Orc.html: Legacy of War: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}}.

Orc.name: Last One Standing (1 / Day)
Orc.html: Last One Standing (1 / Day): When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you are reduced to 1 HP instead.

Orc.name: Battleborn
Orc.html: Battleborn: When you take damage in combat, you become Inspired 1 (1 Extra Die on rolls) until the end of the next round.

instincts.name: Orcish Fury
instincts.html: • Orcish Fury: Gain +2 Movement and 1 Extra Die on your next attack this round, including spells.

High Elf.name: Legacy of the Highborn
High Elf.html: Legacy of the Highborn: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}}.

High Elf.name: Knowledge Cramming
High Elf.html: Knowledge Cramming: Currently Adept (4d6) in {{choices.cramming}}. At the end of a long rest, choose one Standard Skill in which you are untrained. You become Adept (4d6) in it until your next long rest.

High Elf.name: Arcane Affinity I
High Elf.html: Arcane Affinity I: You are Expert (5d6) in Magic. Your two species cantrips can be cast without training in their tradition.

High Elf.name: Arcane Affinity II
High Elf.html: Arcane Affinity II: Cast each of Arcane Shield, Detect Magic, and Magic Missile once per day without Spell Points or empowerment, even without matching tradition training. With matching training, you may also cast them normally using Spell Points.

Wood Elf.name: Legacy of the Wild
Wood Elf.html: Legacy of the Wild: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}}.

Wood Elf.name: Danger Sense
Wood Elf.html:
Danger Sense: During the Beginning Phase of the first round of combat, choose one benefit for that round:

  • Hunt: If you commit to a Fast Action, its roll has advantage.
  • Dodge: Gain +1 Deflection.
  • Run: Gain +2 Movement.

Wood Elf.name: Wild Tongue
Wood Elf.html: Wild Tongue: You can understand and communicate with land and airborne beasts.

instincts.name: Woodstride
instincts.html: • Woodstride: Gain +1 Movement and +1 Deflection until the end of the round.

Imp.name: Legacy of Hell
Imp.html: Legacy of Hell: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}}.

Imp.name: Born of Fire
Imp.html: Born of Fire: You have resistance to Fire damage. When you deal damage with any Strike, you may have it deal Fire damage instead of its normal damage type.

instincts.name: Mischievous Blink (1 / Combat)
instincts.html: • Mischievous Blink (1 / Combat): When beginning to move, teleport that distance to a point you can see within your current movement instead. Your next single-target attack roll this round has advantage.

Dwarf.name: Legacy of the Deep Mountains
Dwarf.html: Legacy of the Deep Mountains: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}}.

Dwarf.name: The Long Battle
Dwarf.html: The Long Battle: At the beginning of each round, while neither Dying nor unconscious, gain temporary HP: 1 at levels 1–4, 2 at levels 5–7, 3 at levels 8–9, or 4 at level 10.

instincts.name: Dwarvish Stubbornness (1 / Combat)
instincts.html: • Dwarvish Stubbornness (1 / Combat): Until the end of the round, gain +2 Fortitude and +2 Will, and you cannot be pushed or become Prone.

Ossian.name: Legacy of the Damned
Ossian.html: Legacy of the Damned: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}}.

Ossian.name: Uncanny
Ossian.html: Uncanny: You have disadvantage on Charm rolls unless disguised and disadvantage on Animal Handling rolls.

Ossian.name: Bonepowder Skin
Ossian.html: Bonepowder Skin: You have resistance to Slashing damage and vulnerability to Crushing damage.

Ossian.name: Occult Affinity I
Ossian.html: Occult Affinity I: You are Expert (5d6) in Magic. Your two species cantrips can be cast without training in their tradition.

Ossian.name: Occult Affinity II
Ossian.html: Occult Affinity II: Cast each of Detect Magic, Eldritch Shield, and Hex once per day without Spell Points or empowerment, even without matching tradition training. With matching training, you may also cast them normally using Spell Points.

Remnant.name: Legacy of the Gods
Remnant.html: Legacy of the Gods: You are Expert (5d6) in {{choices.legacy-expert}}.

Remnant.name: Celestial Levitation
Remnant.html: Celestial Levitation: When you move, you may float a few inches above the ground, ignoring difficult terrain while remaining affected by ground-based environmental hazards. You land when your movement ends. You also fall slowly and take half damage from falling, rounded down.

Remnant.name: Godly Force
Remnant.html: Godly Force: You learn the unique Godly Force cantrip and may cast it even if you are not trained in a matching tradition.

Remnant.name: Divine Affinity I
Remnant.html: Divine Affinity I: You are Expert (5d6) in Magic. Your two species cantrips can be cast without training in their tradition.

Remnant.name: Divine Affinity II
Remnant.html: Divine Affinity II: Cast each of Detect Magic, Healing Touch, and Shield of Faith once per day without Spell Points or empowerment, even without matching tradition training. With matching training, you may also cast them normally using Spell Points.

concoctions.Toughskin Potion: Toughskin Potion (3 CP): Gain +1 Deflection until combat ends or for one minute.
concoctions.Fire Resistance Potion: Fire Resistance Potion (1 CP): Gain Fire resistance until combat ends or for one minute.
concoctions.Acid Resistance Potion: Acid Resistance Potion (1 CP): Gain Acid resistance until combat ends or for one minute.
concoctions.Poison Resistance Potion: Poison Resistance Potion (1 CP): Gain Poison resistance until combat ends or for one minute.
concoctions.Poison Bomb: Poison Bomb (1 CP): Affects a 2-unit square. Roll Bomb Throw against Fortitude. On success, deal 1 Poison damage and apply Discouraged until the end of the next round.
concoctions.Nerve Gas Bomb: Nerve Gas Bomb (1 CP): Affects a 2-unit square. Roll Bomb Throw against Fortitude. On success, the target becomes Vulnerable 1 (−1 to all defenses) until the end of the next round.
concoctions.Burning Bomb: Burning Bomb (2 CP): Affects a 2-unit square. Roll Bomb Throw against Deflection. On success, deal 1 Fire damage and apply Burning 1 until the end of the next round (1 Fire damage at each round’s end; a Fast Action puts out the fire).
concoctions.Acid Coating: Acid Coating (1 CP): Your next Melee Strike or Ranged Strike gains 2 Extra Dice and deals Acid damage.
concoctions.Nerve Coating: Nerve Coating (1 CP): Applies to one Melee Strike or Ranged Strike. On a hit, the target becomes Vulnerable 1 (−1 to all defenses) until the end of the next round.

Light Armor Proficiency.name: Light Armor Proficiency
Light Armor Proficiency.html: Light Armor Proficiency: You are proficient with Light Armor.

Heavy Swinger.name: Heavy Swinger
Heavy Swinger.html: Heavy Swinger: Ignore the Drag from the Heavy weapon property.

Shooter.name: Shooter
Shooter.html: Shooter: Ignore the Drag from the Ranged weapon property.

Tough.name: Tough
Tough.html: Tough: Your maximum HP increases by half your level, rounded down (minimum 1). This bonus scales with your level.

Actor.name: Actor
Actor.html: Actor: While disguised as a real or fictional person, you have advantage on Deception or Performance rolls to convince others you are that person.

Arcane Detection.name: Arcane Detection
Arcane Detection.html: Arcane Detection: You may use Detect Magic without training in Magic. Treat it as Arcane when determining which magical properties you can discern.

Assist in Recovery.name: Assist in Recovery
Assist in Recovery.html: Assist in Recovery: During a long rest, choose an ally or yourself to recover two levels of Exhaustion instead of one. Choose two creatures with Expert Medicine, three with Master, five with Grandmaster, or eight with Legend.

Assurance.name: Assurance
Assurance.html: Assurance: For {{choices.assurance}}, you may forgo rolling and use 2 Success Dice instead.

Cling to Life.name: Cling to Life
Cling to Life.html: Cling to Life: While Dying, you die after three failed death rolls instead of two.

Communicator.name: Communicator
Communicator.html: Communicator: You know two additional non-exotic languages, recorded in Languages.

Deep Sleep.name: Deep Sleep
Deep Sleep.html: Deep Sleep: A long rest removes two levels of Exhaustion instead of one.

Expert Melee Training.name: Expert Melee Training
Expert Melee Training.html: Expert Melee Training: You are Expert (5d6) in Melee.

Expert Ranged Training.name: Expert Ranged Training
Expert Ranged Training.html: Expert Ranged Training: You are Expert (5d6) in Ranged.

Expert Unarmed Training.name: Expert Unarmed Training
Expert Unarmed Training.html: Expert Unarmed Training: You are Expert (5d6) in Unarmed.

Expert Weapon Throw Training.name: Expert Weapon Throw Training
Expert Weapon Throw Training.html: Expert Weapon Throw Training: You are Expert (5d6) in Weapon Throw.

Field Medicine.name: Field Medicine
Field Medicine.html: Field Medicine: You may use Survival instead of Medicine to stabilize a Dying character.

Jumpstart.name: Jumpstart
Jumpstart.html: Jumpstart: Standing from Prone costs 1 unit of movement instead of half your Movement.

Lie Detector.name: Lie Detector
Lie Detector.html: Lie Detector: You may use Deception instead of Insight to detect lies. This does not replace Insight’s other uses.

Natural Medicine.name: Natural Medicine
Natural Medicine.html: Natural Medicine: You may use Nature instead of Medicine to stabilize a Dying character.

Noble Mannerism.name: Noble Mannerism
Noble Mannerism.html: Noble Mannerism: People assume you are a noble unless your behavior reveals otherwise.

Pet.name: Pet
Pet.html: Pet: Your small pet has 2 HP and 1 Deflection. It follows orders unless obviously harmful, cannot deal damage, and does not participate in combat. You may adopt a replacement at any time.

Secret Languages.name: Secret Languages
Secret Languages.html: Secret Languages: You know two additional exotic languages, recorded in Languages.

Sprinter.name: Sprinter
Sprinter.html: Sprinter: Gain +1 Movement when using Dash or Charge.

Train Wild Animal.name: Train Wild Animal
Train Wild Animal.html: Train Wild Animal: You may try to train a wild animal as a temporary pet. If trained in Nature, roll both Animal Handling and Nature and add their Success Dice. With the Pet feat, you may keep it permanently if it meets that feat’s requirements.

Ferocious.name: Ferocious
Ferocious.html: Ferocious: Grants the Strike True Instinct ability. (See its description under Instinct Abilities.)

instincts.name: Strike True (1 / Day)
instincts.html: • Strike True (1 / Day): When performing Melee Strike, Unarmed Strike, Ranged Strike, or Weapon Throw, roll with advantage.

Focused.name: Focused
Focused.html: Focused: Grants the Cast Marvelously Instinct ability. (See its description under Instinct Abilities.)

instincts.name: Cast Marvelously (1 / Day)
instincts.html: • Cast Marvelously (1 / Day): When performing Cast a Cantrip, Cast a Spell, or Bomb Throw, roll with advantage.

Inspired.name: Inspired
Inspired.html: Inspired: Grants the Become Inspired Instinct ability. (See its description under Instinct Abilities.)

instincts.name: Become Inspired (1 / Day)
instincts.html: • Become Inspired (1 / Day): When rolling a Standard Skill, roll with advantage. Usable outside combat.

Courageous Leader.name: Courageous Leader
Courageous Leader.html: Courageous Leader: Grants the Instill Courage Instinct ability. (See its description under Instinct Abilities.)

instincts.name: Instill Courage
instincts.html: • Instill Courage: During the Action Phase, choose an ally within range and roll Leadership. Shorten its Frightened and Discouraged durations by 1 round per SD.

Demoralize.name: Demoralize
Demoralize.html: Demoralize: Grants the Demoralize Instinct ability. (See its description under Instinct Abilities.)

instincts.name: Demoralize
instincts.html: • Demoralize: During the Beginning Phase, choose an enemy within 6 units and roll Intimidation against Will. On success, it becomes Discouraged SD until the end of the round. Once per enemy per combat.

Push Through Pain.name: Push Through Pain
Push Through Pain.html: Push Through Pain: Grants the Push Through Instinct ability. (See its description under Instinct Abilities.)

instincts.name: Push Through (1 / Day)
instincts.html: • Push Through (1 / Day): During the Action Phase, roll 4d6 and heal SD HP.
